text:
Erin: FYI I see host-side CPU p99 bump after last night's rollout. Small-text workloads worst hit. :thinking_face:
Sam: yep. spike looks like combined parse + tokenize + grpc writev fragmentation. quick flame: host_tokenize + grpc_writev + parse_proto.
Kevin: which rollout? kernel picker change or the chunk splice change?
Erin: both landed close. PR 1287 adjusted writev coalesce and PR 1293 changed kernel_picker thresholds. infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-22T23:40 -> rolled 2026-03-23T02:10 UTC :white_check_mark:
Maria: digging traces, kv_cache_hit for short requests dropped ~15% after the splice. chunk reassembly seems to alter prefixing on some requests.
Sam: microbench shows extra memcpy per frame (~100-140ns) from the new splice path; multiplied by many small frames that explains ~2-3ms extra latency.
Kevin: curious: kernel_picker now favors int8 path for small shards. int8 kernels have more prep memcpy and different buffer alignment; maybe that amplifies the memcpy cost.
Erin: I tried forcing fp16 in staging — cpu & p99 improved. Can we run a 5% A/B preferring fp16 for requests <16 tokens?
Zach: setting up a 5% canary routing short-text traffic now.
Maria: also plan: add a short-lived buffer pool to avoid alloc/memcpy churn during proto splice. low-risk and should cut the per-frame cost.
Sam: I'll prepare a revert for the kernel hint and add a perf matrix comparing int8/fp16 for small batches.
Kevin: longer term: kernel_picker should consider expected kv_cache_hit and batch-size together before picking quantized kernels. That'd avoid expensive paths when cache hits dominate.
Erin: agreed. immediate plan: 1) canary A/B (Zach) 2) buffer-pool PR (Maria) 3) kernel hint revert PR + perf tests (Sam) 4) KV key audit to ensure chunking didn't change keys (Maria).
Zach: canary live. initial 15m snapshot: p99 down ~2.7ms on canary vs rolled prod. host_cpu trending down. holding for 30m.
infra-bot: canary metrics: host_cpu +8% vs pre-roll baseline on control; canary -3% vs current prod. kv_cache_hit delta: control 0%, prod after-roll -17%.
Sam: I'll attach the harness config and the flamegraph snippet to the PR. reproducible locally.
Maria: added telemetry sentinel to snapshot chunking prefixes (no PII) so we can diff keys before/after.
Kevin: if the buffer pool helps, we can keep kernel hint revert until we ship adaptive kernel_picker that uses batch+kv heuristics.
Erin: thanks. keep updates short here. If canary worsens, we'll rollback immediately. :pray:
